categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Newway Photomask Making Co., Ltd. specializes in the research, development, production, and sales of photomasks used in flat panel displays, semiconductors, touchscreens, and circuit boards. Their product portfolio includes quartz photomasks, soda photomasks, and others, serving industries such as TFT-LCD, AMOLED, Mini/Micro-LED displays, semiconductor IC manufacturing and packaging, touchscreens, and PCB/FPC manufacturing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced photolithography techniques including laser direct writing for high-precision patterning on photomask substrates. They have developed proprietary manufacturing technologies for G2.5 to G11 generation photomasks, including multi-tone and halftone photomasks, LTPS, AMOLED, and semiconductor photomasks down to 150nm process nodes. Core technologies also include optical proximity correction (OPC), phase shift mask (PSM) technology, advanced coating and cleaning processes, defect control, and packaging technologies. They have a strong R&D focus on improving precision, defect control, and expanding product applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are major flat panel display manufacturers such as BOE, TCL Huaxing, Tianma Microelectronics, and Xinli, as well as semiconductor companies including SMIC Ningbo, Tongfu Microelectronics, Jingfang Technology, Huatian Technology, and Sanan Optoelectronics. The company serves the flat panel display, semiconductor, touch, and circuit board industries, with products critical for display panel fabrication, semiconductor chip manufacturing and packaging, and touch panel production.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Shenzhen and Chengdu. It serves domestic customers extensively and has some international sales. The company’s supply chain includes key suppliers from Japan, South Korea, Sweden, and Germany. The company is listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange Sci-Tech Innovation Board (STAR Market).
categories.supply_chain_position: Newway Photomask operates upstream in the semiconductor and flat panel display supply chain as a key materials and equipment supplier. It produces photomasks which are essential lithography templates used in downstream manufacturing of displays, semiconductors, touchscreens, and circuit boards. The company also invests in upstream materials and equipment suppliers to strengthen the supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on advancing photomask technology to support high-generation flat panel displays (G11 and below), high-precision halftone photomasks, and semiconductor photomasks for mature and advanced process nodes including third-generation semiconductors. R&D priorities include developing LTPO, PSM photomasks, flexible display photomasks, and improving coating, cleaning, and defect control technologies. The company also invests in upstream materials and equipment to promote domestic substitution and supply chain security.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized photomask products to flat panel display manufacturers, semiconductor fabs, and other downstream customers. The company operates on a make-to-order production model, with sales recognized upon delivery and customer acceptance. It also earns investment income from equity investments in related companies and financial assets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with international photomask manufacturers such as DNP, HOYA, SKE, LG-IT, and Toppan, which dominate high-end photomask markets. Newway is the only domestic company capable of producing full-generation photomasks (G2.5-G11) and ranks third globally in G11 photomask sales with a 21.5% market share. It is a leading domestic player driving import substitution and technological advancement in China’s photomask industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 672 million, a 5.06% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 148.8 million, up 24.23%. Total assets reached RMB 2.32 billion, growing 19.88% from the prior year. The company’s R&D investment increased by 23.91% to RMB 35.2 million, accounting for 5.24% of revenue. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory with expanding production capacity and improving profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Newway Photomask emphasizes high-precision, high-quality photomask products that directly impact downstream product yield and quality. It differentiates itself through comprehensive generation coverage (G2.5 to G11), advanced proprietary technologies breaking foreign monopolies, and strong R&D capabilities. The company offers customized solutions, strong customer service, and a commitment to supporting domestic supply chain security and import substitution, positioning itself as a trusted partner in the flat panel display and semiconductor industries.
